decision.rationale: The current images and operational entrypoints work, but the real product profile correctly refuses publication because no evidence-sufficiency method has passed selection. A synthetic AnyHit control cannot establish a releasable configuration.
limitations: The verifier raises before writing a partial per-check JSON result, so this record retains the sanitized failing endpoint and refusal code rather than a complete request ledger.
The run used synthetic data, deterministic generation, local Caddy trust, and one development machine.
Public DNS, trusted TLS, clean-host restore, real-source quality, professor fidelity, and human usability remain pending.
The V7 42/42 result proves mechanics under an injected test control, not product evidence-sufficiency selection.
